verses.english: “Mendicants, form is impermanent, decaying, and perishing.
and consciousness are impermanent, decaying, and perishing.

verses.pali: Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṁ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṁ vuccati saddhānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṁ, sappurisabhūmiṁ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṁ;
verses.english: Someone who has faith and confidence in these teachings is called a follower by faith. They’ve stepped into the sure path, they’ve stepped into the level of the true person, and they’ve passed beyond the level of the untrue person.

verses.pali: abhabbo taṁ kammaṁ kātuṁ, yaṁ kammaṁ katvā nirayaṁ vā tiracchānayoniṁ vā pettivisayaṁ vā upapajjeyya;
verses.english: They can’t do any deed which would make them be reborn in hell, the animal realm, or the ghost realm.

verses.pali: abhabbo ca tāva kālaṁ kātuṁ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṁ sacchikaroti.
verses.english: They can’t die without realizing the fruit of stream-entry.

verses.pali: Yassa kho, bhikkhave, ime dhammā evaṁ paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṁ khamanti, ayaṁ vuccati: ‘dhammānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṁ, sappurisabhūmiṁ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṁ;
verses.english: Someone who accepts these teachings after deliberating them with a degree of wisdom is called a follower of teachings. They’ve stepped into the sure path, they’ve stepped into the level of the true person, and they’ve passed beyond the level of the untrue person.

verses.pali: abhabbo taṁ kammaṁ kātuṁ, yaṁ kammaṁ katvā nirayaṁ vā tiracchānayoniṁ vā pettivisayaṁ vā upapajjeyya;
verses.english: They can’t do any deed which would make them be reborn in hell, the animal realm, or the ghost realm.

verses.pali: abhabbo ca tāva kālaṁ kātuṁ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṁ sacchikaroti’.
verses.english: They can’t die without realizing the fruit of stream-entry.

verses.pali: Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṁ pajānāti evaṁ passati, ayaṁ vuccati:
verses.english: Someone who understands and sees these principles is called
a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.”
The Linked Discourses on stepping into are complete.
